# pve_nodes (Data Source)

All nodes visible to the API endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_nodes" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) CPU utilization.
- `level` (String) Support level.
- `maxcpu` (Number) Number of available CPUs.
- `maxmem` (Number) Number of available memory in bytes.
- `mem` (Number) Used memory in bytes.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `ssl_fingerprint` (String) The SSL fingerprint for the node certificate.
- `status` (String) Node status.
- `uptime` (Number) Node uptime in seconds.
